object_name: Old smartphone with a swollen battery
condition: The back panel is pushed out by a swollen lithium-ion battery and the screen has lifted at one corner. The phone does not power on.

hazards: Swollen lithium-ion battery that can catch fire if pressed, punctured or charged
Screen glass that may crack as the battery expands
safety.handling_warning: Do not charge, press or open the phone. Keep it in a metal tin or on a non-flammable surface, away from heat, until you drop it off.

recovery_plan.destination: Authorised e-waste recycler or brand take-back point; tell them the battery is swollen
Authorised e-waste recycler, left attached to the phone
Authorised e-waste recycler as one unit; do not take it apart
